mechanism: Replace fixed case summarization followed by a confidence MLP with a response-trained local case weighting encoder. Values remain actual case power increments. Same-unit cases are excluded at both fitting and inference. Static original-key support and 32-case local pools remain train-only; the learned encoder only reranks these cases. Fit two convex execution coefficients on fitting labels, not on selection/calibration.
evidence: Training early period, event0/state5: 352 eligible physical queries and151 old cases; standardized key distance vs response dissimilarity correlation0.259979. Cross-unit nearest32 response MSE0.0214996 vs all-cross0.0246746 shows locality is partly useful but responses remain heterogeneous. Fixed response readout h1 MAE146.1472 vs base145.4042, h2 MAE210.2909 vs214.7732. This supports testing response weighting, not a guaranteed fix.
proposal_objective: Same MIXED .8 absolute+.2 squared error on capacity-normalized case proposal residual. Proposal supervision is independent of the execution alpha, so exact-zero fallback does not kill the retrieval gradient. No new label rows.
confidence: After each proposal epoch, exact convex fit_shrinkage on the same1045 fitting windows, constrained [0,1] and joint MAE/MSE non-worse on fit. No grid or validation threshold search. Epoch0 is exact common-base fallback.
selection: Same115-window training-only selection; joint MAE/RMSE non-worse score;20 epochs only
benefit_calibration: Same110 later donor training windows, min24 windows, min3 units,2/3 positive units. New actual-output certificate bound to learned checkpoint, source bank, view implementation, scaler and common numerical gate. No reduction of old utility thresholds.
controls: Reuse completed numerical, free Wiki, zero-memory and old-key/short-key anchored controls without retraining. Add FixedKernel: exact same cross-unit local pools and episode priors, fixed original-key distance, two fitting-only convex coefficients, no neural fitting or searched epochs. This is a mechanistic baseline, not a parameter-matched ablation.
primary_success: ResponseAttentionSelective must jointly improve MAE/RMSE over CertifiedNumeric/Persistence, v9 DynamicsWikiSelective, old CaseAnchoredWikiSelective, FreeWikiSelective, ZeroMemorySelective and new FixedKernelSelective. Always report raw outputs but do not promote them after outer inspection.
budget: One new fold1 seed2024 proposal encoder20epochs plus deterministic FixedKernel confidence fit. No completed-control retraining or automatic fold/seed expansion.
scope: Wiki executor only; same case rows/outcomes, source-unit labels, numerical arrays/scaler/backbone/gate and target cohorts. No NWP or future query covariates. The old memory remains frozen; no refreshing based on outer labels.
limitations: One historically inspected development fold, not independent confirmation or proven novelty. Learned weighting can overfit scarce/correlated donor episodes. Hash identity proves which executor ran, not guaranteed transport. FixedKernel has fewer fitted degrees of freedom; report this rather than claim matched capacity.
